data_status: STRICT MODE: this dataset contains only values that were compared with, or ingested directly from, retrieved sources: JPL (SSD, SBDB), NASA (NSSDC fact sheets and mission catalog, Small Spacecraft SoA report 2026, SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit, NTRS papers, ), ULA, ESA, NIST, and the Launch Library 2 aggregator. Records carry source_authority/confidence where the source is an aggregator or vendor-reported compilation. Recalled, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, engine/vehicle specs without a retrievable source, the user-supplied SpaceX table) are not included. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

record.name: Magnetometer (MAG)
record.description: The Magnetometer (MAG) on MESSENGER is designed to measure the magnetic field of Mercury at all points in the spacecraft's orbit with the scientific objective of producing a three-dimensional model of Mercury's magnetosphere. Results will also be combined with the charged particle observations to study substorms and magnetic reconnection. A total data return of roughly 440 Mb is expected over the one year nominal mission. MAG is a three-axis ring core fluxgate magnetometer mounted on a 3.6 m boom in the anti-sunward direction. In orbit, the instrument will operate in the range of -1024 to +1024 nT, digitized to 16-bits to provide 0.03 nT resolution. The detector sampling rate is 40 Hz and readout rates are selectable from 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 20, or 40 Hz. Averaging intervals can be selected from 0.025 to 1 s. Digital filters provide selectable bandpassed channels of magnetic field variation.
